veyra_p1.desc: Veyra Ashmantle, Rift-Warden, phase 1 MIST (5x, rime-plate = boss plate): violet-black long coat under ice-blue rime-armour, crown of runes, frost-lantern. Real Veyra: breath-fog fx + shadow decal (the tell).

veyra_p2.desc: Veyra phase 2 FREEZE (5x): ice shards grow off the pauldrons; she freezes the four portals.

veyra_p3.desc: Veyra phase 3 WARDEN (6x): the plate grows spikes, red grief-cracks open on the weak points, red eyes; cold-fire beam (red ring telegraph).

veyra_p4.desc: Veyra phase 4 ASK (5x): she stops attacking; plate pale and cracking, head bowed, lantern low and guttering. die = she dissolves into snow (Ending B) -- Ending A reuses idle.

veyra_clone.desc: Veyra mist clone (P1, x3): the P1 figure drained pale and dithered, NO breath-fog and NO shadow (the real one has both); Hrefna rings it violet.
